issues.description: The problem statement and UML describe the SealSaloon.orders attribute as a modifiable List<Meal>, but the reference implementation declares orders as a Meal[] array. This mismatch in the expected type for the orders attribute can confuse students (should they implement a List or an array?) and may lead to inconsistent implementations or test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the representation consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement and UML to specify orders as Meal[] (array) or change the reference implementation to use a modifiable List<Meal> (e.g., ArrayList<Meal>) for the orders attribute and adapt related code. Ensure the templates and tests match the chosen representation.
